## Set-up

```{r}
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(knitr)

# Read dataset
ufc_model <- readRDS("ufc_model.rds")

# Keep only the columns we need and remove NAs
ufc_clean <- na.omit(ufc_model[, c("Winner", "R_age", "B_age", "R_Height_cms", "B_Height_cms","R_Reach_cms", "B_Reach_cms", "R_avg_SIG_STR_landed", "B_avg_SIG_STR_landed", "R_avg_TD_landed", "B_avg_TD_landed", "R_avg_SUB_ATT", "B_avg_SUB_ATT", "R_wins", "B_wins", "R_odds", "B_odds", "r_dec_odds", "b_dec_odds", "r_sub_odds", "b_sub_odds", "r_ko_odds", "b_ko_odds", "B_current_lose_streak", "B_current_win_streak", "R_current_lose_streak", "R_current_win_streak", "R_longest_win_streak", "B_longest_win_streak")])

# Normalize predictors (0 to 1)
normalize <- function(x) {
  return((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

ufc_norm <- as.data.frame(lapply(ufc_clean[, -1], normalize))
ufc_norm$Winner <- ifelse(ufc_clean$Winner == "Red", 1, 0)

# Split the dataset
ratio <- 0.7
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(ufc_norm), ratio * nrow(ufc_norm))
ufc_train <- ufc_norm[train_rows, ]
ufc_test  <- ufc_norm[-train_rows, ]
```

## Make Baseline Model

```{r}
ann_base <- neuralnet(
    Winner ~ ., 
    data = ufc_train, 
    hidden = 2,
    threshold = 0.05,
    linear.output = FALSE,
    stepmax = 1e5
)

# Plot network architecture
plot(ann_base, rep = "best")
```

## Evaluate Baseline Model

```{r}
# Generate predictions
p_base <- compute(ann_base, ufc_test[, -ncol(ufc_test)])$net.result
cls_base <- factor(ifelse(p_base > 0.5, "Red", "Blue"), levels = c("Blue", "Red"))
actual   <- factor(ifelse(ufc_test$Winner == 1, "Red", "Blue"), levels = c("Blue", "Red"))

cm_base  <- confusionMatrix(cls_base, actual, positive = "Red")
roc_base <- roc(ufc_test$Winner, as.vector(p_base), quiet = TRUE)

# Confusion Matrix Heatmap
cm_base_df <- as.data.frame(cm_base$table)
ggplot(cm_base_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "skyblue", high = "black") +
  labs(title = "Baseline ANN Confusion Matrix",
       x = "Actual Winner",
       y = "Predicted Winner") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Improved Model

```{r}
ann_imp <- neuralnet(
    Winner ~ ., 
    data = ufc_train, 
    hidden = 5,
    threshold = 0.05,
    linear.output = FALSE,
    stepmax = 1e5
)

plot(ann_imp, rep = "best")
```

## Improved Model Evaluation

```{r}
# Generate predictions using the best repetition
p_imp   <- compute(ann_imp, ufc_test[, -ncol(ufc_test)], rep = which.min(ann_imp$result.matrix["error", ]))$net.result
roc_imp <- roc(ufc_test$Winner, as.vector(p_imp), quiet = TRUE)

# Find optimal probability threshold from ROC curve
best_thresh <- coords(roc_imp, "best", ret = "threshold")$threshold[1]
cls_imp     <- factor(ifelse(p_imp > best_thresh, "Red", "Blue"), levels = c("Blue", "Red"))

cm_imp <- confusionMatrix(cls_imp, actual, positive = "Red")

# Confusion Matrix Heatmap (Improved)
cm_imp_df <- as.data.frame(cm_imp$table)
ggplot(cm_imp_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgreen", high = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = paste0("Improved ANN Confusion Matrix (Cutoff = ", round(best_thresh, 3), ")"),
       x = "Actual Winner",
       y = "Predicted Winner") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Model Comparison

```{r}
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Baseline ANN (1 Layer: 2 Nodes)", 
            "Tuned ANN (1 Layer: 5 Nodes, Optimal Cutoff)"),
  Accuracy = c(round(cm_base$overall["Accuracy"], 4), 
               round(cm_imp$overall["Accuracy"], 4)),
  Sensitivity = c(round(cm_base$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4), 
                  round(cm_imp$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4)),
  Specificity = c(round(cm_base$byClass["Specificity"], 4), 
                  round(cm_imp$byClass["Specificity"], 4)),
  AUC = c(round(auc(roc_base), 4), 
          round(auc(roc_imp), 4))
)

kable(summary_table, align = "lcccc", caption = "Test Set Performance Comparison")
```
